metadata.description: Comprehensive Ghana-specific barbershop FAQ dataset for Marconi's Barber Shop chatbot

questions.question: How much is a haircut?
questions.response: Our classic haircut is ₵50, fade starts at ₵55, and a haircut with beard combo is ₵70. Kids cuts are ₵35. We offer great value for quality service!

questions.question: How much is a beard trim?
questions.response: A beard trim is ₵30, beard shaping ₵35, and a full hot towel shave is ₵40. We also have a haircut + beard combo for ₵70.

questions.question: Do you offer student discounts?
questions.response: Yes! We offer a 10% student discount on all services Monday through Thursday. Just bring your valid student ID.

questions.question: What services do you offer?
questions.response: We offer classic haircuts, fades, beard trims, hot towel shaves, kids cuts, hair dyeing, scalp treatments, and facial massages. All services include a complimentary neck shave and style consultation.

questions.question: Do you do dreadlocks?
questions.response: Yes! We offer dreadlock maintenance including retwisting, palm rolling, interlocking, and starter locs. Pricing starts at ₵60 depending on length and style.

questions.question: Do you do braids?
questions.response: We specialize in men's braiding including cornrows, straight backs, Ghana braids, and box braids. Prices start from ₵80 depending on complexity.

questions.question: Do you offer hair dyeing?
questions.response: Yes! We offer professional hair coloring including jet black, blond highlights, grey blends, and fashion colors. Prices start at ₵120. We use quality Schwartzkopf and L'Oreal products.

questions.question: What is a hot towel shave?
questions.response: A hot towel shave is our premium traditional shaving experience. We apply hot towels to soften your beard, use pre-shave oil, then shave with a straight razor. Followed by a cold towel and moisturizer. It's ₵40 and takes about 30 minutes.

questions.question: Do you do scalp treatments?
questions.response: Yes! We offer deep cleansing scalp treatments for dandruff, dry scalp, and product buildup. Including steam therapy and nourishing oils. Prices from ₵55.

questions.question: How often should I get a haircut?
questions.response: For most styles, we recommend every 2-3 weeks to maintain your look. Fades and tapers need touch-ups every 1-2 weeks. Our regular customers typically visit twice a month.

questions.question: How do I care for my fade?
questions.response: To maintain your fade: wash with mild shampoo 2-3 times a week, moisturize daily, and visit us every 1-2 weeks for a refresh. Avoid hats right after a fresh cut.

questions.question: What products should I use for my hair type?
questions.response: For African hair textures, we recommend sulfate-free shampoos, leave-in conditioners, and natural oils like jojoba or argan. We stock SheaMoisture, Cantu, and local Ghanaian shea butter products.
variations: What to use on my hair

questions.question: How do I deal with dandruff?
questions.response: We recommend our anti-dandruff scalp treatment (₵55). At home, use a gentle shampoo, avoid over-washing, and apply tea tree or peppermint oil. Our barbers can assess your scalp and recommend the best approach.

questions.question: How do I grow my hair faster?
questions.response: For healthy hair growth: get regular trims (every 6-8 weeks), massage your scalp daily, use biotin-rich products, eat protein-rich foods, and stay hydrated. We also offer hot oil treatments to stimulate growth.

questions.question: Do you accept Mobile Money?
questions.response: Yes! We accept MTN Mobile Money, Vodafone Cash, and AirtelTigo Money. You can also pay with cash or card. All mobile money payments are instant.

questions.question: Where are you located in Accra?
questions.response: We are located at 123 Barber Street, Osu, Accra. Near the Osu Oxford Street junction, opposite the Total filling station. You can't miss our red and white sign!

questions.question: What are your opening hours?
questions.response: We are open Monday to Saturday from 8:00 AM to 8:00 PM. Sundays from 12:00 PM to 6:00 PM. We're closed on public holidays.

questions.question: Do you operate on Sundays?
questions.response: Yes! We are open on Sundays from 12:00 PM to 6:00 PM. Sundays are popular so we recommend booking in advance.

questions.question: How do I book an appointment?
questions.response: You can book online through our website, call us at 0599363145, or visit us in person. Online booking is available 24/7 and you can choose your preferred barber and time slot.

questions.question: Can I book a specific barber?
questions.response: Absolutely! When booking online or over the phone, just request your preferred barber. We have profiles of all our barbers so you can see their specialties.

questions.question: How early should I book?
questions.response: For weekends and evenings, we recommend booking 2-3 days ahead. Same-day bookings are often available, especially on weekday mornings. Walk-ins are welcome too!

questions.question: Can I cancel my booking?
questions.response: Yes! You can cancel or reschedule up to 2 hours before your appointment at no charge. Just call us or use your booking confirmation link.

questions.question: What if I'm late for my appointment?
questions.response: We hold your slot for 15 minutes. If you're running late, please call us. For delays over 15 minutes, we may need to reschedule to avoid affecting other customers.

questions.question: Is there parking available?
questions.response: Yes! We have free parking for customers behind the shop. There's also street parking available on Barber Street.

questions.question: Are you open on public holidays?
questions.response: We are closed on major public holidays including Independence Day, Eid, Christmas, and New Year's Day. A notice is posted on our door and social media a week before.

questions.question: How many barbers do you have?
questions.response: We have 6 experienced barbers, each with 5+ years of experience. Our team includes specialists in fades, traditional cuts, beard styling, and hair design.

questions.question: Which barber is best for fades?
questions.response: All our barbers are skilled at fades! Kofi and Emmanuel are particularly known for their precision fade work. You can see their work in our gallery.

questions.question: Do you cut children's hair?
questions.response: Yes! We love cutting kids' hair. Children aged 0-12 get a special rate of ₵35. We have lollipops, cartoons playing, and patient barbers who are great with children.

questions.question: What age do you start cutting hair?
questions.response: We accept children from 6 months old. For babies and toddlers, we recommend coming during quieter hours (mornings weekdays) for a calmer experience.

questions.question: Do you do wedding haircuts?
questions.response: Yes! We offer premium wedding packages including groom and groomsmen styling. Includes consultation, trial session, and on-site services on your wedding day. From ₵150.

questions.question: Can you come to my event?
questions.response: Yes! We offer mobile barber services for events including weddings, birthday parties, corporate events, and photoshoots. Minimum booking is 5 people. Contact us for a quote.

questions.question: Do you have a loyalty program?
questions.response: Yes! Our Loyalty Club gives you 1 point per ₵10 spent. Every 10 points earns you a ₵10 discount. Members also get early access to promotions and birthday discounts.

questions.question: How do I join the loyalty program?
questions.response: Just ask at the counter or sign up during online booking using your phone number. It's free and you start earning points from your first visit!

questions.question: Do you accept credit cards?
questions.response: Yes! We accept Visa, Mastercard, and Amex. We also accept mobile money (MTN, Vodafone, AirtelTigo) and good old cash.

questions.question: Do you offer refunds?
questions.response: We stand by our work. If you're not satisfied with your haircut, please let us know within 24 hours and we'll fix it free of charge. Refunds are offered on a case-by-case basis.

questions.question: How often should I wash my hair?
questions.response: For African hair types, we recommend washing 1-2 times per week with a sulfate-free shampoo. Over-washing can strip natural oils. Co-washing (conditioner only) between washes is great.

questions.question: What's the best oil for my hair?
questions.response: For African hair, we recommend jojoba oil, argan oil, or sweet almond oil. Local Ghanaian shea butter is excellent for sealing in moisture. We stock all of these in our shop.

questions.question: How do I prevent ingrown hairs?
questions.response: To prevent ingrown hairs: exfoliate gently before shaving, shave in the direction of growth, use a sharp blade, and apply a moisturizing aftershave. Our hot towel treatment also helps.

questions.question: What hairstyle would suit me?
questions.response: Our barbers provide free style consultations. We analyze your face shape, hair texture, and lifestyle to recommend the perfect cut. Book a consultation anytime!

questions.question: What are the trending hairstyles in Ghana?
questions.response: Popular styles right now include: low and mid fades, burst fades, curly top fades, afro-textured crops, and designs/partings. Our barbers stay updated with global trends.

questions.question: Can you do hair designs?
questions.response: Yes! Our barbers are skilled in hair designs including lines, zigzags, geometric patterns, and custom artwork. Design prices start at ₵15 added to any haircut.

questions.question: How do I grow a fuller beard?
questions.response: For a fuller beard: be patient (it takes 4-6 weeks), use beard oil daily, brush regularly to stimulate follicles, eat a protein-rich diet, and consider our beard growth treatment (₵45).

questions.question: What beard services do you offer?
questions.response: We offer beard trimming (₵30), beard shaping (₵35), full beard grooming with hot towel (₵50), and beard dye/greying (₵40). We use premium beard products.

questions.question: How do I maintain my beard?
questions.response: Daily routine: wash 2-3 times weekly, apply beard oil daily, brush with boar bristle brush, trim edges weekly, and visit us every 2-3 weeks for professional shaping.

questions.question: Do you offer straight razor shaves?
questions.response: Yes! We offer professional straight razor shaves (₵40). It includes hot towel prep, pre-shave oil, lather, the shave itself, and a soothing aftershave balm. Very relaxing!

questions.question: Is a straight razor shave safe?
questions.response: Absolutely. Our barbers are trained professionals who use new, sterilized blades for every customer. We follow strict hygiene protocols including sanitizing all equipment between uses.

questions.question: Do you offer corporate accounts?
questions.response: Yes! We offer corporate accounts for businesses. Benefits include priority booking, monthly invoicing, discounted rates for groups of 5+, and on-site barber services. Email info@marconis.com for details.

questions.question: Do you sell gift cards?
questions.response: Yes! We offer digital and physical gift cards from ₵50 upwards. Perfect for birthdays, holidays, or any occasion. Buy online or in-store.

questions.question: How long does a haircut take?
questions.response: A standard haircut takes 20-30 minutes. A haircut with beard combo takes 40-50 minutes. Hot towel shaves take about 30 minutes. We never rush quality!

questions.question: Do I need to make an appointment?
questions.response: Walk-ins are always welcome! However, booking is recommended, especially for weekends and evenings, to avoid waiting. You can book online 24/7.

questions.question: What COVID-19 measures do you have?
questions.response: We maintain high hygiene standards: all equipment is sterilized, hand sanitizer is provided, our shop is well-ventilated, and our staff follows health guidelines.

questions.question: Can I bring my own products?
questions.response: Of course! You're welcome to bring your own shampoo, conditioner, or styling products. We're happy to use what works best for your hair.

questions.question: What hair products do you sell?
questions.response: We stock a range of quality products: beard oils and balms, pomades, hair creams, shampoos, conditioners, and local Ghanaian shea butter. Ask at the counter for recommendations!

questions.question: Do you sell beard oil?
questions.response: Yes! We have our own Marconi's Beard Oil (₵25) made with jojoba, argan, and essential oils. Also available in sandalwood and peppermint scents.

questions.question: Do you speak Twi?
questions.response: Yes! Our barbers speak English, Twi, Ga, and Hausa. We serve customers from all backgrounds and make everyone feel at home.

questions.question: Do you play music in the shop?
questions.response: Yes! We play a mix of highlife, afrobeat, hiplife, and contemporary music. It's a relaxed, friendly atmosphere where you can unwind.

questions.question: Are your barbers trained?
questions.response: All our barbers are fully trained with 5+ years of experience. Many hold certifications from top barbering schools in Ghana and abroad. We invest in continuous training.

questions.question: How do I prevent hair breakage?
questions.response: To prevent breakage: moisturize daily, avoid tight hairstyles, use a wide-tooth comb, sleep with a satin bonnet or pillowcase, and get regular trims. Our deep conditioning treatment (₵45) helps too.

questions.question: Do you have any packages or combos?
questions.response: Yes! Our popular combos: Haircut + Beard ₵70 (save ₵10), Full Grooming Package ₵120 (haircut, beard, facial), and Student Special ₵45 (Monday-Thursday with ID).

questions.question: Do you offer facial massages?
questions.response: Yes! Our facial massage (₵35) includes cleansing, exfoliation, massage with essential oils, and moisturizing. It's a great add-on to any haircut for total relaxation.

questions.question: Is there a waiting area?
questions.response: Yes! We have a comfortable waiting area with air conditioning, free WiFi, water, and magazines. You can also watch TV while you wait.

questions.question: Can I book for a group?
questions.response: Yes! We accept group bookings for teams, wedding parties, and events. For groups of 3+, please call us at 0599363145 to coordinate simultaneous appointments.

questions.question: What is a taper vs a fade?
questions.response: A fade gradually blends hair from short to skin-length, usually on the sides and back. A taper is a shorter gradient that doesn't go down to the skin. Fades are more dramatic, tapers are more conservative. We can show you examples!

questions.question: Should I use conditioner?
questions.response: Yes! Conditioner is essential for maintaining moisture and softness. Use a leave-in conditioner daily and a deep conditioner weekly. We recommend sulfate-free products for African hair.

questions.question: Do you sell pomade?
questions.response: Yes! We stock Murray's Pomade, Dax Wave and Groom, and our own Marconi's Premium Pomade (₵30). Available in light, medium, and strong hold.

questions.question: Is there WiFi at the shop?
questions.response: Yes! Free high-speed WiFi for all customers. Ask at the counter for the password.

questions.question: My child is scared of haircuts. Any tips?
questions.response: We're great with nervous children! We recommend: coming during quiet hours, bringing a favorite toy, letting them watch another child first, and our barbers are patient and gentle. Many kids end up loving it!

questions.question: Do you do graduation haircuts?
questions.response: Yes! We offer special graduation packages including haircut, beard grooming, and style consultation. Group discounts available for classmates. Book early during graduation season!

questions.question: Do you offer regular barber services for offices?
questions.response: Yes! Our Corporate Barber Program brings a barber to your office on scheduled days. Employees can book 15-minute slots. Perfect for busy professionals. Call 0599363145 to set up.

questions.question: What is your most popular service?
questions.response: Our Haircut + Beard Combo (₵70) is by far the most popular. It gives you a complete fresh look and saves you ₵10. Our classic fades are a close second!

questions.question: How do I style my afro?
questions.response: For a great afro: keep it moisturized, use a wide-tooth afro pick, shape it by trimming the edges, and apply a light hold product. Visit us for professional shaping (₵45).

questions.question: Do you offer hair steaming?
questions.response: Yes! Our hot oil steam treatment (₵55) opens hair cuticles for deep conditioning, promotes growth, and relieves dry scalp. Very popular during the harmattan season!

questions.question: Do you have air conditioning?
questions.response: Yes! Our shop is fully air-conditioned for your comfort. No need to worry about Accra heat while getting your haircut.

questions.question: What if I don't like my haircut?
questions.response: No worries! If you're not satisfied, let us know before you leave and we'll adjust it for free. Customer satisfaction is our priority.

questions.question: Can I request a specific barber style?
questions.response: Yes! Each barber has specialties. Check our website for barber profiles and portfolios. Kofi is our fade specialist, Emmanuel for classic cuts, and John for beard sculpting.

questions.question: Do you do eyebrow grooming?
questions.response: Yes! Eyebrow shaping and unibrow removal (₵15) available as an add-on to any service. We use sterilized tools and professional techniques.

questions.question: Are prices negotiable?
questions.response: Our prices are fixed for the quality and service we provide. However, we regularly run promotions and offer loyalty rewards. Join our Loyalty Club for exclusive discounts!

questions.question: Do you sell cold drinks?
questions.response: Yes! We offer complimentary water, and have soft drinks and bottled water available for purchase while you wait or during your service.

questions.question: What information do I need to book?
questions.response: Just your name, phone number, preferred date/time, and service type. If you want a specific barber, let us know! Online booking takes less than 2 minutes.

questions.question: How do I contact you?
questions.response: Call or WhatsApp us at 0599363145, email info@marconis.com, or visit us at 123 Barber Street, Osu, Accra. We're active on Instagram and Facebook too!
